anomalies.observed: Net 'CS2' in the netlist contains nodes for U1 pin 3 (3V3), U8 pin 1 (FB), L1 pin 2, and all other +3V3 decoupling nodes, as well as U1 pin 21 (GPIO7) and U4 pin 6 (~CS).
anomalies.expected: CS2 should be a separate net connecting only U1 GPIO7 (pin 21) and U4 ~CS (pin 6), while +3V3 should be a separate net with U1 3V3, U8 FB, L1.2, and decoupling capacitors.

evidence.quote: Each chip has its own independent chip-select: ~{CS} (pin 6) on U2/U3/U4 goes to separate nets CS0/CS1/CS2, driven by ESP32 GPIO4/GPIO6/GPIO7 respectively.

anomalies.impact: U4 thermocouple interface is permanently deselected (CS high), so the third thermocouple channel will not work. Additionally, ESP32 GPIO7 is tied to the 3.3V rail, so any attempt by firmware to drive it low will cause a short-circuit/contention, potentially damaging the pin or regulator.

parsed.summary: The netlist shows the CS2 chip-select net is shorted to the +3V3 rail, merging U4's chip-select and ESP32 GPIO7 with the 3.3V supply. This disables the third thermocouple channel and risks damage if GPIO7 is driven low.
